claude-opus.notes: Most capable Claude: deep review, architecture, multi-step reasoning. The alias tracks the latest opus. auto: a classifier approves routine actions and blocks destructive ones, no prompts.

claude-sonnet.notes: Faster Claude for writing, review and routine cross-checks. The alias tracks the latest sonnet.

codex-luna.notes: Fast and cheap: easy tasks and quick checks. A reviewer model gates each command.

codex-sol.notes: Workhorse for coding and careful analysis, long single-task runs.

codex-astra.notes: Frontier model for the hardest tasks. Give it the topic you trust least.

cursor-grok.notes: Protocols, endpoints, code reading, exact numbers. --force auto-approves every command.

cursor-composer.notes: Cursor's own coding model: code reading, search and quick cross-checks. Fast turnaround.
